details.title: Chromatic ladders
details.lead: Every half step, one rung of the ladder at a time, from the bottom of the horn to double high B♭. The valves change on every note, so keep the fingers down firmly and the air steady between them.
facts: E3 to B3, G3 to D4, C4 to G4, F4 to C5, B♭4 to F5, E♭5 to B♭5, B♭5 to F6, E♭6 to B♭6, All of them, low to high, The whole horn: E3 to B♭6 and back
